Date: 10 August 2026 
 
Subject: Submission of audio recording of Earnings Conference Call – Q1 FY 2026-27 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, we wish to inform you that 
the audio recording of the Company’s Earnings Conference Call held today, i.e. Monday, August 10, 
2026, to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter (Q1 FY 2026-27) ended 30 June, 
2026, has been made available on the website of the Company and can be accessed through the 
following link: 
https://jeenasikho.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Earning-Call-Recording-10-08-2026.mp3  
 
Kindly take the above on your records.  
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited 
 
 
Manish Grover 
Managing Director 
DIN: 07557886 
 
Place: Zirakpur, Punjab 
Date: 10.08.2026
